exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: five selected comic panels in one deterministic sequence sheet for CH02 CH02-S06
Primary request: Create a text-free 3-by-2 comic grid. The first five cells are the chronological story sequence below. The sixth cell is a quiet environment-only aftermath motif, never a duplicate character panel.
Scene/backdrop: projected Council address across the engine wall in Veyr, a gravity-rationed city built beside a continent-high vertical ocean.
Characters: Mae Nox, fictional adult woman age 41, tall and broad-shouldered, dark brown skin, one blunt black wedge braid to shoulder blades, ochre work coat, teal rope harness, heavy split-toe boots, practical mature proportions; Dax Pell, fictional adult man age 38, lean, copper-brown skin, silver-black asymmetrical curl crest leaning left, narrow moustache, coral half-cape, charcoal wrap trousers, yellow barometer gauntlet, practical mature proportions; Orra Venn, fictional adult woman age 56, compact, shaved head, white triangular mantle over black load armor, brass plumb-staff, practical mature proportions; Tavi Rusk, fictional adult age 47, round powerful silhouette, indigo head wrap, sleeveless boiler apron over practical clothes, mature proportions.
Non-human subjects: none.
Style/medium: pressure-print comic: bold woodcut-like dry-brush black edges, flat imperfect off-register oxidized teal, warning coral and acid-yellow risograph inks on warm fibrous paper; angular adult proportions, large readable hands, graphic negative-space force paths, simplified backgrounds except for functional machinery, one dominant value break per cell.
Color palette: soot black, oxidized teal, warning coral, warm paper.
Composition/framing: exact clean 3-column by 2-row grid with strong black gutters; one readable moment per cell; varied camera distance; phone-readable silhouettes; the first five cells must read left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
Chronological cells:
Cell 1: Establish projected Council address across the engine wall; show mae, dax, orra, tavi, fictional_adult_crowd; make geography and current load direction obvious.
Cell 2: Intent: secure a repair window; show the responsible adult initiating a concrete step.
Cell 3: Constraint becomes physical and visible: Orra frames South Hook as a threat to city survival.
Cell 4: Causal action: Mae challenges her former mentor with the exposed gauge; show footing, contact, rope or mechanism tension, and force direction.
Cell 5: Consequence and remaining state: Orra orders the district detached at dawn and names Mae compromised; nothing resets between cells.
Irreversible state already in force: official_forecast_disproved, mae_accepts_dax_forecast, south_hook_rib_cracked, mae_right_glove_torn, mae_pull_knot_charged, mae_pull_knot_spent, dax_wanted, public_witnesses_wrong_down, tavi_joins_investigation, engine_alarm_active, weight_diversion_proven, south_hook_knows_diversion, dax_cape_hem_scorched, anchor_heart_stolen.
New state that must visibly persist after this sequence: south_hook_detachment_ordered, mae_named_compromised.
Lettering clearance: cell 1 reserve normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.5, 0.21] as low-detail negative space; cell 2 reserve normalized rectangle [0.54, 0.05, 0.95, 0.2] as low-detail negative space; cell 3 reserve normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.5, 0.21] as low-detail negative space; cell 4 reserve normalized rectangle [0.65, 0.06, 0.94, 0.18] as low-detail negative space; cell 5 reserve normalized rectangle [0.7, 0.74, 0.92, 0.89] as low-detail negative space.
Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unambiguously mature proportions and practical non-sexualized clothing; exact named-character hair, silhouette, wardrobe damage, injuries and equipment persist; coherent anatomy; readable hands; visible physical cause and effect; no spontaneous healing; no extra people unless the cell explicitly calls for a fictional-adult crowd; no glamor posing.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, speech balloons, sound-effect text, logos, signatures, watermarks, floating UI, children, child-coded features, young-looking adults, sexual content, gratuitous gore, real-person likeness, third-party characters, named-artist imitation, glossy 3D, soft clear-line watercolor.
